name: Avax Apparels and Ornaments Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2005, Avax Apparels and Ornaments Ltd is in the business trading
of fabric and online sale of jewellery[1]
keyPoints:
Business Verticals:[1]
a) Wholesale trading:
Company operates in the wholesale trading of knitted cloth. They buy from manufacturers and sell on wholesale basis to companies and readymade garment manufacturers in Punjab. The company specializes in knitted cloth, which are used for manufacturing of ladies and gents' jackets
b) Online retail of silver ornaments:
Company operates in the business of online 
 retail of silver ornaments. They offer a wide 
 range of designs and articles with a choice 
of weight of products, such as silver rings, 
 silver ladies pajeb, silver gents kada, silver 
 plate set, silver glass, silver bangles, silver 
 bowls, silver chains, and other silver jewellery.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 44.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 58.2 to 71.7 days.
